title: Defaulted list lookup within a segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers whose entries are the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$. For every index $i$ less than the length of $l$ and every integer $d$, the value $\mu(a+i)$ equals the list lookup at index $i$ with default value $d$.
hypotheses_covered: The entries of $l$ equal the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$
The index is less than the length of $l$
